paragraphs.source_en: Part of Cassius is gone. That invincible boy I first met is somehow different. The humiliation changed him. I can’t decide how, though, as I straighten his fingers and help him fix his shoulder. He falls down from the pain.

units.source_en: Part of Cassius is gone.
That invincible boy I first met is somehow different.
The humiliation changed him.
I can’t decide how, though, as I straighten his fingers and help him fix his shoulder.
He falls down from the pain.

paragraphs.source_en: “Thank you, brother,” he says to me, and cups the side of my head to help himself up. It is the first time he says it. “I failed the test.” I don’t disagree with him. “I went in there like a plum fool. If this were anywhere else, they would have killed me.”

units.source_en: “Thank you, brother,” he says to me, and cups the side of my head to help himself up.
It is the first time he says it.
“I failed the test.”
I don’t disagree with him.
“I went in there like a plum fool.
If this were anywhere else, they would have killed me.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Least it didn’t cost you your life,” I say.

units.source_en: “Least it didn’t cost you your life,” I say.
Cassius chuckles.
“Just my pride.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. Something you have in abundance,” Roque says with a smile.

paragraphs.source_en: “We have to get her back.” Cassius’s own grimace fades as he looks at Roque, then at me. “Quinn. We have to get her back before he takes her up to his tower.”

units.source_en: “We have to get her back.”
Cassius’s own grimace fades as he looks at Roque, then at me.
“Quinn.
We have to get her back before he takes her up to his tower.”
“We will.”
We bloody will.

paragraphs.source_en: Cassius and I go east according to my plan, farther than we have gone before. We stay to the northern highlands, but we make sure we walk along the high crests visible to the open plains below. East and east, our long legs taking us fast and far.

paragraphs.source_en: “A rider to the southeast,” I say. Cassius doesn’t look.

units.source_en: “A rider to the southeast,” I say.
Cassius doesn’t look.

paragraphs.source_en: We pass through a humid glen where a dark loch offers us the chance to catch a drink across from a family of deerling. Mud covers our legs. Bugs flit over the cold water. The earth feels good between my fingers as I bend to drink. I dunk my head and join Cassius in eating some of our aging lamb. It needs salt. My belly cramps from all the protein.

paragraphs.source_en: “How far east of the castle do you reckon we are?” I ask Cassius, pointing behind him.

units.source_en: “How far east of the castle do you reckon we are?”
I ask Cassius, pointing behind him.

paragraphs.source_en: “Maybe twenty klicks. Hard to peg it. Feels farther but my legs are just tired.” He straightens and looks where I point. “Ah. Got it.”

paragraphs.source_en: A girl on a dappled mustang watches us from the edge of the glen. She has a long covered bar tied to her saddle. Can’t make out her House, but I have seen her before. I remember her like it was yesterday. The girl who called me a Pixie when I fell off that pony Matteo put me on.

She has a long covered bar tied to her saddle.
Can’t make out her House, but I have seen her before.
I remember her like it was yesterday.
The girl who called me a Pixie when I fell off that pony Matteo put me on.

paragraphs.source_en: “I want her horse to ride back,” Cassius tells me. He can’t see out his left eye but his bravado is back, a little too forcefully. “Hey, darling!” he calls. “Shit, that hurts the ribs. Prime ride! What House are you?”

He can’t see out his left eye but his bravado is back, a little too forcefully.
“Hey, darling!”
he calls.
“Shit, that hurts the ribs.
Prime ride!
What House are you?”
I’m worried about this.

paragraphs.source_en: The girl rides to within ten meters, but she has the sigils on sleeve and neck covered with two lengths of sewn cloth. Her face is streaked with three diagonal lines of blue berry juice mixed with animal fat. We don’t know if she is from Ceres. I hope not. She could be from the southern woods, from the east, from the far northeastern highlands even.
